facts.label: Garagem
facts.sub: Em muitas cidades dos EUA, a garagem cobra por hora ou por dia. Você pega um ticket na entrada, estaciona e paga no quiosque antes de sair.

facts.label: Validar o estacionamento
facts.sub: Algumas lojas, restaurantes e escritórios validam seu ticket. Isso significa que o estacionamento fica grátis ou mais barato. Pergunte sempre: Can you validate my ticket?

pages.title: Level three, please · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine o’clock on a busy Monday in Nashville. Lena drives slowly into a big parking lot near the center. A white barrier blocks the way in front of her car. Next to it, an attendant named Walt sits in a small booth. He is old, calm and friendly. Lena stops the car and opens her window.
“Hi! Are you parking for the day?” says Walt. “Yes. I’d like a daily ticket, please.” says Lena. “The daily rate is twelve dollars. Do you have a card?” says Walt.
